question_text:
According to the autobiography of Lee Iaccoca (the then-CEO of Chrysler LLC portrayed in the
movie Ford v/s Ferrari), the company hasn't had a very illustrious history and has had its fair share
of ups and downs. During the 1970s, the company lost its market share and was in danger of going
out of business. When Lee Iaccoca became its CEO, he instituted a number of changes that
ultimately turned the company around. There were other significant developments post Ioccoca's
contribution to the company and he has mentioned all these significant achievements in his
autobiography, published in 1984. Imagining yourself as Lee Iaccoca and considering yourself as an
OD expert, elaborate on what type of behavior science-based interventions you would have initiated
that can potentially change the fate of the company. Use your insights and justify the interventional
approach best suited to this case.

The Late Dr. Denton Cooley has around 65000 open heart surgeries to his credit. He was a
pioneer and instituted the Texas Heart Institute in Houston, Texas. At one time, his team was
handling a tenth of all such operations in the United States. During all his assignments, he has had a
trustworthy team, except that he had developed a rift with Dr Michael E. DeBakey at some point in
time. This rift has stopped his team from becoming a high-performance work system. Do you see
that the effectiveness of his team was threatened because of this rift? Do you see that there are
noteworthy determinants that play a major role and contribute to the effectiveness of his team?
Elaborate with reference to any group effectiveness model that fits this situation.

If we imagine the period of 1910-1950s (MBE), workers and employees endured a different kind
of stress, whereas during the period of 1960s-1990s (MBO), employees witnessed a different kind of
stress. When we imagine the current era (MBV), which is characterized by a dejobbed environment
and organizational culture coupled with mergers and acquisitions, employees are witnessing a
different type of stress. Do you think the employees in all three eras have been experiencing similar
or different type of stress? What would be your approach to explaining stress in different eras and
situations? Do you think a specific model of stress is sufficient to explain stress and have universal
applicability? Suggest some stress management techniques that are suitable for employees or that
would be effective for employees in all three eras.

After graduating from BITS, if you get an opportunity to enter into an entrepreneurial venture
with a couple of your friends, what would be your strategy to function in that startup? Would you
take a transactional leadership role or use a servant leadership style to run that business? If, with
the passage of time, more people join your venture and the total number of employees increases to,
let’s say (N=60), will your team think of making an organizational design decision? What sort of
organizational determinants would you be taking into consideration if your startup is engaged in
producing a specialized product? Elaborate your strategy and design decisions with respect to the
provided situation and justify your choices with your creative imagination.

An organizational psychologist cum consultant has conducted research in an organization
wherein he has distributed two standardized scales to around N=12 employees of the firm. The
consultant was basically interested in seeing the relationship between Variable (a) Friendship types
and Variable (b) Altruistic behaviors. S/he distributed standardized instruments to his/her sample
that were measuring both these constructs and, after data collection, obtained the following scores.
Variable A 50 54 56 59 60 62 61 65 67 71 71 74
Variable B 22 25 34 28 26 30 32 30 28 34 36 40
Using your statistical knowledge, compute the product-moment correlation coefficient so that the
consultant can make a decision on what to do next with the research.

Even though most HRD professionals agree that HRD evaluation is valuable, why isn’t it
practiced more frequently by organizations? Identify and describe at least two reasons why
evaluation might not be done. How can these objections to evaluation be overcome? Do you
see any similarities or differences between Kirpatrick’s original and extended evaluation
framework? Critically evaluate.

With reference to Appendix 7-1 of your textbook (pp 207-217), which provides details
about various research designs, do you see any role of research methodology as a tool for
the HRD professional in evaluating training and development programs? Using your
imaginative power, exemplify a training case where you can use experimental design for
training evaluation. Elaborate your imagination.

How does Levinson’s approach to adult development relate to Greenhaus and
colleagues’ five-stage model of career development? As a career development tool,
mentoring has been linked to potential benefits and problems for organizations and
individuals. Given these potential benefits and problems, describe how you feel about
becoming involved in a mentoring relationship as part of your career development. What
would your concerns be, and what would you like to see an organization do to ensure the
mentoring experience is positive?

Is organizational transformation change a necessity for maintaining an efficient
organization? Why or Why not? Even though there is limited empirical evidence to
support organization transformation change intervention strategies, why do organizations
still use this approach? Identify and describe a situation where you think this approach
would not be effective. Do you think the skills needed for designing and implementing a
human-processual intervention differ from those of a techno-structural intervention?
Elaborate.

Do you see any difference between the pedagogical and andragogical approaches to
instructions? Suppose the CEO of a local hospital asks you to design a program to increase
employee awareness of sexual harassment and train participants to deal with harassment
complaints. Which principles (from either approach) would you utilize without prior
experience and expertise? Support your choices. What are your recommendations to
supervisors for conducting effective training for older workers? Suggest.

What is an Organizational Theory? How is a structure consisting of only 10 employees
different from a structure having 100 employees? What are the major determinants of
any organizational design? Elaborate the determinants that are taken into
consideration while constituting an organization’s structural framework. Exemplify, if
you can.

Describe any group development model and justify the same. Based on your reading
or learning (including movie-watching) experiences, briefly describe the setup,
intention, and inferences of the conformity experiments. In the end, define conformity
as per your understanding.

What are the main differences between the behavioral and contingency approach to
leadership theories? Explain any of the leadership theories that you like and justify
your choice. Do you think 'coercion' as an influence tactic can 'fit in' while
comprehending the idea of leadership? Critically reflect.

What is your conceptualization of an effective group? Explain your favorite model of
group effectiveness. What are the significant determinants of group effectiveness, which
must be kept in mind while gauging the critera? Elaborate with an example.

How do you define stress? What are the various stressors present in an organization
that can thwart your functioning and performance? Suggest ways to mitigate stress in
contemporary organizations and enlist strategies that can enhance well-being of
employees. Choose your favorite context/organization and elaborate hypothetically.

What do you understand by organizational change and development? Differentiate
between the Human Processual and Techno Structural interventional approach using a
hypothetical or real-life example. What do you think an OD consultant does in any
organization? Does s/he use research methodology while formulating the change
paradigm? Elaborate with example/s.

What will be your biggest motivation to join world of work once you finish your
education? What do you mean by motivation? Are there different approaches to
motivation. Explain and elaborate any approach of your choice and justify the same
with an organizational example.

Solve and interpret the following:
Consider the following data obtained by a researcher while conducting research with
(n=15) employees of XYZ organization:
Var A (Worforce Agility): 86; 74; 46; 85; 63; 65; 49; 54; 74; 48; 68; 75; 79; 72; 68.
Var B (Toxicity): 54; 67; 69; 58; 36; 45; 48; 43; 49; 54; 43; 49; 51; 55; 59.
Using the above dataset of 15 employees on workforce agility and toxic cultures,
calculate product-moment correlation and provide a meaningful interpretation as per
your understanding. See, if you can develop a scattergram and a fit line.
_________________________________________________________________________

A news reporter visited war-torn Germany (immediately after WW II) and interviewed a few war
criminals during the Nuremberg trials in the early 1950s. When she asked one war criminal why he
was involved in all those war-related atrocities, he gave a simple answer and said that he was just
following the orders of his superiors. Do you think a typical social-psychological phenomenon is
operating here? What is that phenomenon? Can such a phenomenon be experimentally verified or
studied? If yes, how? Do you think these social-psychological phenomena deeply impact an
individual's psyche? Elaborate your response by considering all the relevant social-psychological
phenomena and drawing inferences from the suggested movies and documentaries. Use your
analytical bent of mind to develop recommendations that can help overcome the problems created by
such social psychological phenomena studied experimentally.

The deputy of Henry Ford got an opportunity to steer a sick company on the verge of bankruptcy in
the 1970s. Chrysler Automobiles has lost its market share and is in danger of going out of business.
When Lee Iaccoca became the CEO, he initiated several changes that ultimately turned Chrysler
around and made it a profit-making company under his leadership. In addition, Lee mentioned other
significant developments in his autobiography, published in 1984. Think of Lee Iaccoca and,
considering yourself an OD expert, elaborate on what type of behaviour science-based interventions
would have been carried out that led to the turnaround of Chrysler LCC. Use your insights, learning,
experience, and knowledge to justify the individual or group-based interventions that would have
been carried out at Chrysler Automotives.

Imagine that you have been working with your preferred organization and feel content with your
third performance appraisal. You have proved your mettle by becoming an indispensable asset to
your employer. As far as the organization's work culture is concerned, you share a very good rapport
with almost all your colleagues and coworkers, except Mr. X, who is a most dreadful arch-rival of
yours. Imagine a situation wherein the management has deputed ten employees (including yourself
and Mr. X) for a challenging yet signature project in the US that needs to be started ASAP. Looking at
this situation, do you think the chosen group members can make an effective team together? Will
there be some storming in the development of a team that can impede the progress of the signature
project? Elaborate on what should be done and how it can be done with the help of relevant team
development models. Is there a way to enhance or ensure the effectiveness or efficiency of the team
for better results? Elaborate.

A researcher is interested in making the causal attribution that engagement in organizational
citizenship and prosocial behaviors at work (variable 1) would lead to a happy and productive work
life (variable 2). In order to prove the hypothesis, the researcher conducts fieldwork in an organization
by distributing two scales to N = 12 department employees, one of which measures OCBs and the
other measures employee satisfaction. Upon scoring and tabulating, if the scores on these two scales
come out to be like those shown below:
Constructs E1 E2 E3 E4 E5 E6 E7 E8 E9 E10 E11 E12
Variable 1 50 54 56 59 60 62 61 65 67 71 71 74
Variable 2 22 25 34 28 26 30 32 30 28 34 36 40
What do you think the researcher should do now to make any causal attribution among the
measurement scores of the chosen constructs? Elaborate on the procedure and methodology and
interpret the values.

Imagine yourself working in a small entrepreneurial venture as the VP (Marketing) located in the
most congested areas of Delhi. The office space is tiny, and there are only three parking spaces in your
office, reserved for the CEO, CFO and VP. The staff strength of the EV is approximately 20, and around
16 individuals work under the four owners who occupy the top positions in the venture. Recently, the
EV has partnered with a new company, and the owner of that organization is now a 40% partner and
shareholder of your EV. With his induction, he often visits your congested office and parks his car in
your parking slot. This has resulted in a rise in your blood pressure, general anxiety and an enhanced
magnitude of anger. You are not able to keep your cool and now suffer from bouts of mood swings.
Do you think this change in you is because of specific physio-chemical changes in your body? How do
you understand this process, and what do you call it? Are there standard theoretical mechanism/s to
comprehend and manage this phenomenon? Explain and elaborate with reference to your
experiential learning.

Considering the various industrious and indolent behaviors displayed by employees in their
respective organizations, highlight the major causes of concern from an employee as well as employer
perspective and suggest remedial measures to control/overcome/manage such behaviors to enhance
organizational effectiveness. You are free to raise concerns not otherwise specified in the text, and,
which you think can address the situation in a logical, rational and legitimate manner. Use your
imagination whilst simultaneously taking help of the literature.

Imagine that after completing your graduation, you enter the world of work by getting yourselves
placed in your preferred company. The day you enter your preferred office, what kind of socialization
tactics would you utilize to get yourself recognized by your employer on all fronts. Suggest the
imbuing practices which you think would be highly practical and feasible while imagining the scenario.
You can also come up with suggestions not covered by any theory in the book.

Critically reflect the major factors that led to the development of the field of organizational
psychology, keeping in mind the role played by the famous Hawthorne experiments. Do you think that
the knowledge generated in this domain is a specialized knowledge and it requires goal-directed
efforts unlike common-sensical knowledge, which any one can presume and predict for applying in
situations experienced by them. Comment.

After having read and understood the various theories of individual motivation, suggest the
implications of the concept of employee motivation in their respective organization/s. And, analyze
the factors that the organizational authorities should deliberate upon to motivate and enhance the
morale of their employees in current and future situations.

Your boss assigns you the task to assess the impact of organizational commitment of your
colleagues on their levels of job satisfaction, how would you analyze this cause-effect relationship
between these two constructs in question? Explain the research process by hypothetically deducing
results for the above-mentioned problem using imaginary data and following the necessary steps to
conclude your research. Please interpret the results briefly for your boss.

Rajeev and Radha are working couple in corporate sector who have recently acquired parenthood
and they have a baby girl. Off late, owing to fierce competition within their respective firms, Rajeev
have heard through office grapevine that there are instances of increasing attrition and layoffs in his
organization. This information has led him to work even harder and as a result he is not able to devote
time to his family. Can we conclude that Rajeev is having some kind of conflict? Elaborate the type of
conflict he is facing in his office. Describe the most significant stressors which can have a potential
impact on his life? What are the various ways through which he can enhance his well-being at his
workplace? Elaborate.

Vikas has recently inherited his father's restaurant business (Haveli Restaurant) which employs a
total staff of around 25 people. His father ran the restaurant successfully for almost two decades
owing to a number of reasons, including prime location, hygienic-tasty food, attributes of waiters and
his fathers' Individualized Consideration (IC) focused transformational leadership style. On the
contrary, Vikas has a different leadership style and he wants to expand this inherited business to a
Pan-India level. If you would have been in place of Vikas, what kind of organizational design decisions
you would have taken to ensure that your plans would materialize in the right direction. Explain your
strategy in light of the present structure of the restaurant and the proposed structure that will
eventually be devised. Do you think that the structure thus conceived would be an organic structure
or a mechanistic structure? Draw relevant blueprints to support suitable organizational designs that
may fit this case.

Varun joined KPMG as an associate consultant some three years back. He impressed his recruiter
with his analytical acumen, leadership skills and is being considered a very intelligent and a diligent
worker. With reference to his work culture, he shares a very good rapport with all types and cadres of
people in his organization, except Ravi, who is his equally competent arch rival. The management has
deputed both of them for a tough project in Singapore that needs to be initiated within a month.
Now, considering the situation, do you think, together, they can form a work team? What kind of
stages will be foreseen in the development of their team while recruiting some 5-7 teammates?
Elaborate as to what should be done and how it can be done by taking help of relevant team
development models. Once chosen comment on its effectiveness. Do you see the role of influence
tactics as potential agents in enhancing the team development process?

Jet Airways (India) Private Limited got bankrupt after ruling the Indian market for almost 26 years.
All their flight operations were temporarily suspended on April 17, 2019 and the entire fleet was
grounded. As for company's founder, Naresh Goyal completed his graduation in Commerce in 1967
and joined the travel business at the tender age of 18 as a general sales agent (GSA) for the Lebanese
International Airlines. Now, while comparing scenarios, when Chrysler was in similar situation during
1970s, Lee Iacocca, the then CEO instituted a number of changes that ultimately turned the company
around and saved its existence. Imagining yourself as an OD consultant, elaborate what type of
behavior science-based interventions you would carry out if you are hired to revive Kingfisher Airlines.
Do you think the NPA's (created by bad loans of Vijay Mallya, Mehul Choksi etc.) were the prime
reasons, banks denied relief package and loans and may potentially render OD interventions at jet
ineffective? Use your insights and schematically describe the individual or group-based interventions
that you would carry out if you are given that opportunity.

A consultant was hired to look into a hypothetical problem faced by a large manufacturing firm.
When he was oriented about the problem by the management, the Vice-President (HR) told him that
the organization employs around 5000 employees in different departments each with different
knowledge, skill and abilities. Looking at the huge population of the employees there, the consultant
decided to do a research by including viewpoints of all the stakeholders in the organization. Imagine
yourself as that consultant, elaborate the steps of the proposed research undertaken to investigate
the nature and complexity of that problem. While you put yourself in the shoes of that consultant,
suggest the management how the hypothetical problem can be studied;
A) Using a quasi-experimental paradigm, and,
B) Using a different research methodology.
Also, suggest the management whether any specific type of statistics would be applicable to the
collected data and how inferences from that data would be helpful in deriving a solution to that
hypothetical problem. If you have to provide nomenclature to the hypothetical problem after you
complete your research, what might be that?
